title: Volta Labs Launches AXELIOS 1 Library Prep App on Callisto™
summary: Volta Labs launches the AXELIOS 1 Library Prep App on Callisto™, in collaboration with Roche Diagnostics.
body_markdown:
Volta Labs today announced the AXELIOS 1 Library Prep App on the Callisto™ Sample Prep System, in collaboration with Roche Diagnostics.


[Read the press release on Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261112418672/en/Volta-Labs-Launches-AXELIOS-1-Library-Prep-App-on-Callisto%E2%84%A2)


Callisto™ is For Research Use Only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures.
